subject: Clear exit evidence & acceptance sprint plan for Synapse eval
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@synapsetx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clear exit evidence & acceptance sprint plan for Synapse eval

Hi Elaine,

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on the primary evaluation goals. As promised, I'm attaching a short mutual action plan (MAP) draft that focuses specifically on exit evidence and acceptance tests so we (and your stakeholders) have a deterministic close path. Key asks in this note:

- Confirm the acceptance test window (we're proposing week of June 29)
- Confirm procurement lead / PO timeline so we can schedule infra and test accounts
- Flag any extra security evidence you need (SOC2 artifacts, audit log format, residency proofs)

High level of the MAP-draft-v2.xlsx:
- Exit gates: functional correctness (NLP concordance >= 92%), throughput/latency (p95 < 350ms for 512 tokens), cost target (avg token cost < $0.0009), audit & retention verification
- Acceptance tests: smoke harness, sample dataset pass/fail, security checklist, SRE soak test (24h)
- Owners: Synapse provides test dataset + success sign-off; Redwood owns test harness, logs, and evidence export
- Contingency: Canary rollout + automatic fallback to smaller model if latency or errors spike

I attached MAP-draft-v2.xlsx and a concise procurement-checklist.pdf to make the procurement step easier. If the PO hits by June 18 we can absolutely deliver the acceptance test run the week of the 29th.

Proposed next step: if you confirm procurement timeline, Ben will share the test-run playbook and Connor will schedule infra.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12 rows)
Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf (1 page)

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@synapsetx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Synapse Procurement <procurement@synapsetx.com>, Thomas Li <thomas.li@synapsetx.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clear exit evidence & acceptance sprint plan for Synapse eval

Hi Marissa — thanks for consolidating.

High-level response: this is very close to what our stakeholders want. A few clarifications / asks from the security and procurement teams:

- Security: We will need SOC 2 Type II summary, a statement of data residency (we must keep test data in us-west-2), and an example of exported audit logs (timestamp, user-id, request-id).
- Success criteria: concordance metric is good; can you define the exact test script that produces the 92%? We need reproducibility to sign off.
- Procurement: Our procurement team needs a templated SOW and a draft PO line items estimate by EOD June 18. Can your team provide a one-page SOW + estimate?

We can target the week of June 29 for the acceptance run but we need the SOW/PO on the 18th to clear internal approvals. If procurement can’t make the 18th we'll need to push to mid-July.

I will loop our legal only if the SOW includes any atypical data handling clauses; otherwise procurement will route the PO.

Thanks — Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of ML Ops, Synapse Therapeutics
elaine.park@synapsetx.com
Attachment referenced: procurement-questions.xlsx (they will upload separately)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@synapsetx.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clear exit evidence & acceptance sprint plan for Synapse eval

Thanks, Marissa / Elaine — quick breakdown of the acceptance tests and evidence we’ll deliver (owners and pass conditions):

1) Functional concordance (owner: Ben)
   - Test: 3 curated prompt cohorts (clinical summarization, triage routing, free-text extraction) run against ground-truth set (n=250).
   - Pass: macro F1 >= 0.92 for extraction, and summary ROUGE-L >= target (we'll publish scripts).
   - Evidence: raw outputs + scoring script + reproducibility notebook uploaded to shared Drive.

2) Performance & SLOs (owner: Grace)
   - Test: parallel load runner (100 concurrent requests) + 24h soak at baseline traffic.
   - Pass: p95 latency < 350ms, error rate < 0.5% sustained.
   - Evidence: latency histograms, traces, KV cache hit rates.

3) Cost target (owner: Marissa)
   - Test: run representative job mix and report token cost; pass if avg token cost <= $0.0009.

4) Security & audit (owner: Redwood Security team; contact: connor.obrien)
   - Test: provide SOC2 summary, sample audit-export (CSV), and KMS integration notes.
   - Pass: Synapse confirms fields/format are acceptable.

I've put the detailed test harness and the security-evidence-summary.pdf on Drive here: https://drive.redwood.com/synapse/MAP-draft-v2.

If procurement confirms PO timing, we will lock schedules and publish the step-by-step runbook. I attached a short security-evidence-summary.pdf that addresses Elaine's initial asks.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachment: security-evidence-summary.pdf (3 pages)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@synapsetx.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clear exit evidence & acceptance sprint plan for Synapse eval

Marissa / Grace — operational notes and timeline:

- Infra booking: we can reserve a dedicated GPU pool for the week of Jun 29 but must have the PO/commit by EOD Jun 18. If PO misses the date, we can still run a reduced-capacity test but latency targets may be higher; we'll document the delta.
- Test accounts: Synapse needs two test accounts (one for extraction workflow, one for summarization) and a small sample dataset (max 2GB) in us-west-2. Please confirm the bucket path and IAM role so we pre-provision access.
- Contingency plan: if p95 exceeds target during initial ramp, our rollout policy will automatically switch to a smaller quantized model variant and notify the Synapse test leads.

Action items assigned:
- Marissa: finalize one-page SOW and send to Synapse procurement by Jun 16 EOD.
- Ben: publish reproducibility scripts to the shared Drive by Jun 18.
- Grace: reserve infra and share booking link once PO is confirmed.

If Elaine confirms test-account details this week we can keep the Jun 29 target. Otherwise we should propose Jul 13 as the fallback.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

Procurement confirmed they will route the PO to my inbox by EOD Jun 18 (they asked me to confirm the one-page SOW and estimate). I will send the test dataset bucket path and IAM contact to Marissa by Thursday.
